cells.title: Book an All-on-6 Consultation in Los Angeles | West LA Implants

props.text: Leave your details and the front desk calls to find a time. At the visit Dr. Barriere scans, reads the scan with you, and tells you plainly what he would do.
Reviewed by Dr. Tony Barriere, DDS
He plans, places and restores every implant himself.
A cone-beam CT scan of your mouth and jaw
An honest read on candidacy: four implants or six
A written plan, with insurance and financing worked out
“I actually look forward to going to the dentist.”
Tell us where to reach you
The front desk calls to find a time and checks your benefits before you come in.
We reply within one business day. Prefer to talk?
Leslie, Emily and Michael each agreed to be filmed. Hover to see them; click to watch the full story.
“Full Arch All-On-4 gave me my confidence back.”
“I felt like the old me because of my crowns and dental implants.”
“I have teeth again thanks to my full mouth reconstruction.”
Dr. Barriere plans, places and restores every implant himself, in one office on Wilshire.
“Dr. Barriere is a dentist who sees a long-term vision for my dental health. He’s on my team, advising me on my behalf, instead of just someone I visit for procedures.”
“He is very careful with his implant technique. He makes sure the implant has plenty of time to heal into the jawbone. I am confident he will do a good job with the implant crown.”
“Dr. B was the first person to say, ‘I’m going to do everything. We’re going to do it all in this chair.’”

Individual results vary. Photographs and films show patients of West LA Implants. Treatment, candidacy and fees are determined after an examination and a 3D scan; nothing on this page is a quote or a guarantee of a result. All-on-4® is a registered trademark of Nobel Biocare.
